ignore_reasons./data/source_sha256: whole-file hash of the LIVE canonical CSV, which the collector appends to every trading day. It is recorded as provenance only. The reproducibility guarantee is /data/analysis_slice_sha256, which is NOT ignored and which equals the sha256 of k1729_source_snapshot.csv listed in inputs.
ignore_reasons./data/n_rows_available_at_runtime: row count of the live CSV at run time; grows daily for the same reason.

notes: k1729.py reads the live canonical data/intraday/taifex_5min_rv.csv and truncates it at DATA_AS_OF='2026-07-16'. k1729_source_snapshot.csv is that truncated slice, frozen; its sha256 is byte-identical to /data/analysis_slice_sha256 in the result. So a re-run reproduces exactly even as the collector keeps appending rows, and a replicator without the live file can verify the analysed data from the snapshot.
